market_question: Will New People (NL) gain the most seats in the next Russian parliamentary election?
reasoning: New People gained 13 seats in 2021, barely missing the top gainer spot (KPRF gained 15). Current polling (late 2024–2025) shows them around 5–7%, similar to 2021, with no clear catalyst for a surge. Given the dominance of United Russia and the established protest-party alternatives (KPRF, LDPR), it is more likely that another party posts the largest net seat increase, making New People's odds below the implied 28%.
evidence_points: 2021 election: KPRF gained 15 seats, New People gained 13; no party gained more
Polls in 2024–2025 consistently show New People at 5–7%, same as 2021 base
The party lacks a high-profile leader or event to drive a significant seat increase
sources_consulted: Political analysis of Russian party dynamics
